tokens.name: asphalt-950
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. Tinted near-black, never pure #000.

tokens.name: asphalt-900
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, project bays, nav bar fill.

tokens.name: asphalt-800
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: hovered cards, open menus, table header rows, secondary button hover.

tokens.name: asphalt-700
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and card borders (decorative only, 1px). Not for control borders.

tokens.name: asphalt-500
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary button, inputs, chips) on asphalt-950 and asphalt-900, 3.0:1+. On asphalt-800 it drops to 2.8:1, so raise to chalk-400 there.

tokens.name: chalk-100
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on asphalt-950, -900 and -800 (15:1+). Tinted, never pure white.

tokens.name: chalk-400
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, HUD labels on asphalt-950, -900 and -800 (6.6:1+).

tokens.name: drift-red
tokens.usage: THE accent. Primary button fill, brake lights, tyre-smoke backlight, the third word of a hero stack set 24px+. With on-red text (5.0:1). As text under 24px use signal-red instead.

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: Red text under 24px on asphalt-950, -900 and -800 (4.9:1+): eyebrow labels, active nav item, PRO class text.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on drift-red fills (5.0:1).

tokens.name: livery-sky
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px solid), links in long copy, SPORT class. 6.7:1+ on every asphalt.

tokens.name: livery-navy
tokens.usage: COMPETITION class badge fill (with chalk-100 text) and the middle band of the livery stripe. Never as text on asphalt (2:1).

tokens.name: signal-amber
tokens.usage: Sodium lights, warnings, the tachometer redline zone, the Garage section accent. Text-safe on every asphalt (9.4:1+).

tokens.name: headlight
tokens.usage: Headlight flares and beam cones in the intro; car body highlight streaks. Light only, never a surface.

tokens.name: smoke
tokens.usage: Tyre smoke particles and skid-mark fog over asphalt-950. Decorative only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The giant name behind the car. One per screen. On the site use clamp(5rem, 22vw, 15rem).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero stack, uppercase, each word on its own line, last word in drift-red.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Project titles, spec sheet headers, uppercase.

styles.name: hud-label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, sector codes, chip text, table headers.

styles.name: hud-data
styles.usage: Numbers, telemetry, lap times, spec values. Tabular figures.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: AI systems that stay in line when things go sideways.
styles.usage: Hero sub-line and section intros. Max 56ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ask questions about annual reports and get cited answers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding pair (with space-6 horizontal), list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter (minimum), card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section header to content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop (64px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, badges. DRIFT is square-cut by default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, toasts, tachometer ticks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, project bays, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and the avatar ring only.

tokens.name: glow-red
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, brake-light bloom, active sector marker.

tokens.name: glow-headlight
tokens.usage: Headlight flare in the intro; hovered project bay rim.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Hovered project bay and open menus. Never on resting cards.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-ui
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, tab switches.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: A choreographed section entrance (darkness, light, elements, settle).

tokens.name: ease-launch
tokens.usage: Objects accelerating away (power3.in).

tokens.name: ease-brake
tokens.usage: Objects arriving and braking (power3.out).

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Settle with overshoot, like a car on its suspension (back.out 1.4).

tokens.name: ease-travel
tokens.usage: Camera and scroll travel (power2.inOut).
